ashok:
## Your job in one line

Prove that money, stock, validation and tenant isolation are always right, and give an honest go/no-go for every release. You are the **QA lead**: you own the test strategy, the 15 critical scenarios, the release QA report, and QA for the core modules (pricing, purchase, inventory, POS, wholesale, GST, payments, accounting, platform, auth, desktop, integrations). Meyyarivu, Prakalya and Nitheesh also run QA for the areas they didn't build; you review their test cases and keep one standard.

## You own (CODEOWNER)

- `docs/testing/` (strategy, plans, test cases, reports)
- `apps/web/tests/e2e/` (Playwright)
- `backend/meno-api/src/test/java/.../scenarios/` (end-to-end business scenarios)
- `contracts/test-vectors/` **format** and runner (content with Prakalya)
- API collections (`docs/testing/api-collections/`, Bruno or Postman)

**Frontend** (prefixes CAT, PTY, RET, CMP in OWNERSHIP_MATRIX.md)
- `apps/web/src/features/catalog/`: medicine master, generics/salts, brands, manufacturers, units, barcodes, export/history (backend: Kamesh)
- `apps/web/src/features/parties/`: suppliers, customers, doctors, customer groups, statements, supplier price lists (backend: Kamesh)
- `apps/web/src/features/returns/`: sales and purchase returns, inspection, credit/debit notes (backend: Kamesh)
- `apps/web/src/features/compliance/`: Schedule H/H1/X registers, prescription register, narcotic stock (backend: Kamesh)

Use Meyyarivu's `packages/ui` components and page patterns; read `apps/web/AGENTS.md` and `docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md` before your first screen. **You don't QA your own screens:** Prakalya runs QA for CAT, PTY, RET and CMP. The reports centre and analytics (RPT, ANX) moved to Gokul on 25-11-2026, so you now QA Gokul's pricing, GST and delivery screens (PRC, GST, DLV).

## Handoffs

| You receive | From | You give | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stories + acceptance criteria | Prakalya | Test cases (before dev starts) | Developers |
| Features on staging | Team | Defects with steps, expected vs actual, evidence | Owner of the feature |
| Release candidate | Nitheesh | QA report + release recommendation | Nitheesh |
| Contract PRs (OpenAPI) for masters, parties, returns, compliance | Kamesh | Your screens with `data-testid`s | Prakalya / Meyyarivu (QA), Prakalya (UAT) |

## Your AI agent

`.claude/agents/qa-engineer.md` — drafts test cases from stories, writes Playwright/API tests, finds missing edge cases. You verify the expected values yourself.

## Defect rules

Severity: **S1** data corruption / wrong money / cross-tenant leak / can't bill → blocks release · **S2** major feature broken, workaround exists · **S3** minor · **S4** cosmetic. Every S1 gets a regression test before it is closed.

## Definition of done (a feature is "QA passed" when)

All acceptance criteria tested · critical scenarios touching it pass · no open S1/S2 · E2E test added for the happy path · result recorded in the sprint test report.

Phase tasks: PHASE_PLAN.md
gokul:
## Your job in one line

Build the screens people **read and decide from**: pricing and schemes, GST, role dashboards, the reports centre and analytics, CRM and engagement, delivery and online channels. All on Meyyarivu's page patterns, in the same "paper and ink" look, with numbers that are always exact.

Joined: 25-11-2026 (P0 Foundation). Nitheesh is your manager; **Meyyarivu is your frontend buddy** for the first month (pairing, UI review, first PRs).

## You own (CODEOWNER)

**Frontend** (prefixes PRC, GST, DSH, RPT, ANX, CRM, ENG, DLV, OMN in OWNERSHIP_MATRIX.md)

| Web feature folder | What | Backend owner | QA |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/features/pricing/` | Price lists, schemes (free qty, slab), discounts, margin rules, approvals (PRC) | Kamesh | Ashok |
| `apps/web/src/features/gst/` | GST settings, HSN summary, GSTR-1 / 3B preparation and export, e-invoice and e-way bill screens (GST) | Kamesh | Ashok |
| `apps/web/src/features/dashboard/` | Role-based landing, retail / wholesale / inventory / finance / branch dashboards, widget library (DSH) | Nitheesh | Meyyarivu |
| `apps/web/src/features/reports/` | Reports centre and analytics on the `ReportPage` pattern, filters, export (RPT, ANX) | Nitheesh | Meyyarivu |
| `apps/web/src/features/crm/` | Customer history, follow-ups, refill reminders, campaigns (CRM, ENG) | Nitheesh | Prakalya |
| `apps/web/src/features/delivery/` | Home delivery orders, riders, tracking (DLV, later phases) | Nitheesh | Ashok |
| `apps/web/src/features/channels/` | Store page, customer app, marketplace orders (OMN, later phases) | Nitheesh | Meyyarivu |

You **don't** own `packages/ui`, the app shell, `lib/`, `hooks/` or design tokens: those are Meyyarivu's. Need a shared component? Open a Hub task for her (see CONFLICT_FREE_COLLABORATION.md). **You don't QA your own screens:** Ashok tests PRC, GST, DLV; Meyyarivu tests DSH, RPT, ANX, OMN; Prakalya tests CRM, ENG.

## Why these areas need care

- **Pricing and GST are money.** Display amounts with `formatMoney` and do any client-side maths with `decimal.js` / `@meno/billing-engine`. Never JS `number` for money or tax. Rules: CALCULATIONS.md.
- **GST is statutory.** Screens prepare, validate and export; they never say "filed". Only build a rule that is confirmed in COMPLIANCE.md.
- **Dashboards and reports must match the books.** Every figure comes from the API; you never recompute totals in the browser. Filters, rates, periods and option lists come from the API or settings, never hard-coded.
- **Tenant and branch scope** come from the session. Never send `tenantId` from the UI.

## Handoffs

| You receive | From | You give | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stories + acceptance criteria | Prakalya | Screens on staging | QA owner of the prefix (above), Prakalya (UAT) |
| OpenAPI contract PR for pricing, GST (merged before you start) | Kamesh | `data-testid`s on key elements | Ashok |
| Report, dashboard, CRM, delivery, channels API contracts | Nitheesh | Questions on missing fields (in the issue, never invented) | Kamesh / Nitheesh |
| `packages/ui` components, page patterns (ListPage, FormPage, ReportPage, DocumentGrid), UI review | Meyyarivu | Requests for new shared components (Hub task) | Meyyarivu |
| Generated `api-client`, `billing-engine` | Nitheesh | PRs for review | Meyyarivu (UI), Nitheesh (approval) |

## Working before the backend is ready

Once the contract PR is merged, generate the client and build against **MSW mocks** (`apps/web/src/lib/mocks/`). Switch the mocks off when the endpoint reaches staging. Never invent fields that aren't in the contract.

## Your AI agent

`.claude/agents/frontend-engineer.md`. Give it the Hub task, the story, the reference screen in `docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md` and the generated types. Run `pnpm check:design` after every change. You review every line it writes: you are the author of the PR.

## Screen recipe

1. Route `apps/web/src/app/(app)/<area>/page.tsx`: thin, client component.
2. Query hooks in `features/<area>/queries.ts` (keys in `lib/query/keys.ts`, your own section).
3. Form: React Hook Form + Zod schema from `packages/validation`.
4. Components from `packages/ui` only. Tokens only. lucide icons only.
5. Reports: `ReportPage` pattern (filter bar, server pagination, export through the API).
6. Unit tests for pure logic; `data-testid` for E2E.
7. Check Light/Dark at 1280 px and 375 px; keyboard-operable.

## First week

1. Day 1–3: ONBOARDING.md (read, set up, first PR).
2. Read AGENTS.md, apps/web/AGENTS.md, DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md, VALIDATION_AND_BUSINESS_RULES.md, GLOSSARY.md and HOW_A_PHARMACY_WORKS.md.
3. MENO Hub → Learn: learning guide and developer guide; sign in with the email you were invited with and change your password.
4. Work your tasks in **Step** order: MENO Hub → My tasks, or TASK_ORDER.md.

## Definition of done

`pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:design` green · no `any` · no JS `number` for money · keyboard-operable · matches reference screens · UI review by Meyyarivu · approved by Nitheesh.

Phase tasks: PHASE_PLAN.md

Platform, finance, reporting and notification modules are Nitheesh's (`auth`, `tenancy`, `identity`, `audit`, `files`, `sync`, `notification`, `payment`, `accounting`, `reporting`). Use their `api/` packages; ask for changes through a PR.

| You receive | From | You give | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| FRS + stories | Prakalya | Endpoints + OpenAPI spec (**merged first as a contract PR**) | Meyyarivu |

| Bugs | Ashok | Migration notes for deploys | Jeeva |
| Test vectors | Prakalya/Ashok | Passing Java engines | Nitheesh |

`.claude/agents/backend-engineer.md`. Give it the issue, the module `AGENTS.md`, and the FRS section. Always ask it for tests first (cross-tenant + business rule), then implementation.

## Module recipe (follow every time)

1. Migration `V<timestamp>__<module>_<what>.sql` (tenant_id, RLS, indexes, audit cols, version).
